# PowSys Engineering Inc.

> PowSys Engineering Inc. is a woman-owned electrical engineering and technical
> services firm founded in 2017 and based in Calgary, Alberta, Canada. It serves
> the oil and gas, mining, renewable energy, utility, commercial and data centre
> sectors across Canada and the United States.

PowSys delivers engineering solutions either as complete end-to-end projects or
as a contractor, vendor or partner within a client's project. Services span
design, development, integration, risk and relationship management, project
planning and control. Work is delivered offsite from the Calgary office, fully
onsite at a client facility, or as a mix of both.

**Credentials:** APEGA (Alberta), Engineers and Geoscientists British Columbia,
APEGS (Saskatchewan), RCDD (Registered Communications Distribution Designer),
Alberta Fire Safety Association, ComplyWorks.

**Contact:** info@powsysengineering.com · +1 (866) 269-0545 ·
5538 1A St SW, Calgary, AB T2H 0E7, Canada (by appointment only)

## Services

- [All services](https://powsysengineering.com/services): overview of the six service lines, how a project is delivered in five stages, and sector context.
- [Engineering & Design](https://powsysengineering.com/services/engineering-design): power system studies (arc flash, harmonic, fault, protective device coordination, TRV/RRRV, motor starting, islanding and load shedding, transient stability, ground grid), FEED, detailed engineering, design basis memoranda, automation and control.
- [Compliance & Verification](https://powsysengineering.com/services/compliance-verification): QA/QC, FAT/SAT/IFAT testing, process safety audits, code reviews, equipment validation, written schemes of verification, HAZOPs.
- [Project Management](https://powsysengineering.com/services/project-management): ISO 9001-aligned delivery, scope development, costing, subcontract management, cost and schedule control, risk management, and an embedded single-engineer model.
- [Condition-Based Maintenance](https://powsysengineering.com/services/condition-based-maintenance): infrared thermography, partial discharge and tan delta testing, motor current signature analysis, rotor shorted turns detection, root cause analysis, criticality analysis.
- [Data Centre Solutions](https://powsysengineering.com/services/data-centres): power system studies, interconnection design, fault and coordination assessment across phased build-outs.
- [Commercial Sector Solutions](https://powsysengineering.com/services/commercial-sector): life safety systems, RCDD-led telecommunications infrastructure, electrical assessment and design.

## Industries

- [All industries](https://powsysengineering.com/industries)
- [Oil & Gas](https://powsysengineering.com/industries/oil-and-gas): hazardous area (EEHA) classification, equipment selection, inspection and verification dossiers.
- [Renewable Energy](https://powsysengineering.com/industries/renewable-energy): solar PV, wind, hydro, landfill gas, hybrid interconnection, full life-cycle power system management.
- [Mining](https://powsysengineering.com/industries/mining): shutdowns and turnarounds, refurbishment, site audits, reliability and economic studies.
- [Utilities & Power](https://powsysengineering.com/industries/utilities): substation automation, protection and control, transmission line switching studies.

## Knowledge Centre

Technical articles, guides, field notes and opinion at
[the Knowledge Centre](https://powsysengineering.com/knowledge-centre). Topics
include arc flash studies and CSA Z462, partial discharge testing, the
difference between condition-based and predictive maintenance, hazardous area
verification dossiers, solar interconnection delays, data centre rack density
and power system limits, power system model drift, and the limits of infrared
thermography.
